description: MiniMax-M3 (428B, unpruned) as Sebesky's W4A16 GPTQ checkpoint on two Sparks with vLLM tensor parallel 2 over the native multi-node executor: b12x nvfp4 KV cache for the sparse MSA layers, the indexer and dense layers 0-2, Marlin int4 MoE, EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with Sebesky's int4 drafter and a 196,608-token context (upstream lane A, the balanced verified configuration; an fp8-KV variant is an option). Basis: a3refaat's spark-vllm-docker minimax-m3-4bit-w4a16 stack (MIT) as reproduced and extended by tonyd2wild (two build patches, lane recipes). The image is a re-pinned reproduction, not a byte-identical rebuild of upstream's locally built image: vLLM 979b56a6 (MiniMax-M3 release merge) with the fused fp8-KV patch and the Rust tool parser, FlashInfer 0.6.12 built from source, the zyang-dev NCCL mesh fork, the vendored b12x library and the lane's mods are built in the recipe's own Dockerfile with pinned commits, an exact Rust toolchain and PyPI frozen at 2026-07-05. Lanes B (KVarN, drafterless) and C (KVarN plus EAGLE3) use mutually exclusive mods and are not packaged. Upstream figures (36.6 tok/s JSON and 31.8 code at 196K context, 208K-token KV pool, single stream, thinking disabled) are claims until measured here; Vonk physical two-Spark acceptance is pending. License: MiniMax Community License (free for non-commercial use; commercial use has attribution, notice and authorization conditions; prohibited-use appendix), shown as information only. Thinking mode default is chosen per request (chat template kwargs or sampling parameters), not as a recipe option; server default: thinking_mode adaptive (upstream default). Memory follows the creator: GPU utilization 0.929, the value tonyd2wild's lane A runs (DEFAULT-CONFIG.md: 0.93 failed vLLM's startup free-memory check by 0.02 GiB on their pair, 0.925 left too small a KV pool for 196K), and 0.9375 for the fp8 choice (upstream's fp8 EAGLE3 recipe). The earlier 0.82 cut failed on two Sparks on 2026-11-03 (operation 4bcb4352): the weights took 105.8 GiB per rank, more than the 0.82 budget, and vLLM found no memory for KV cache blocks (-6.46 GiB). The declared peak is the admission maximum, an estimate until the run measures it.
title: MiniMax M3 W4A16 GPTQ EAGLE3 vLLM two Sparks
